summary: Multi-shift Operating Hours feature verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 12/12 pass (/app/backend/tests/test_operating_hours.py). PUT /api/vendor/hours: valid weekly schedule => 200; overlapping shifts => 400 ('Shifts overlap on ...'); close<=open => 400 ('close time must be after open time'); >2 shifts/day => 400 ('You can add at most 2 shifts on ...'). Ops POST /api/ops/vendors and PUT /api/ops/vendors/{id} accept and persist a full weekly `hours` map (7 days) with 2 shifts per day, and reject invalid hours with 400 through the same _validate_hours() helper. GET /api/ops/vendors/{id} returns normalized `hours`. Public GET /api/restaurants and /api/restaurants/{id} include is_open, open_status_text, today_shifts, next_open_display and full weekly hours via _vendor_public (note: detail endpoint wraps under `vendor` key). POST /api/orders/create BLOCKS with 400 'This restaurant is closed right now. Opening again at ...' when outside all shifts, and rejects invalid shift_start/shift_end not in today's remaining shifts with 400 'Selected pickup time is no longer available.'. Frontend (Expo web, mobile 390x844) — Vendor Dashboard → Settings → 'Operating Hours' card renders HoursEditor for all 7 days with time boxes, remove-X, 'Add another shift' when only 1 shift, testID copy-monday, testID save-hours-btn; Copy Monday to all days works; Save Hours calls PUT /api/vendor/hours (observed HTTP 200 on the wire) and shows success. Home restaurant card shows 'Open' pill when within a shift and 'Closed' pill otherwise. Restaurant detail page shows a green 'Open now' chip + 'Today: 3:42 PM–5:12 PM, 5:42 PM–6:42 PM' hours line when open; when closed it shows a red 'Opening again at 5:44 PM' chip. Checkout when OPEN shows 'PICKUP SLOT' section with a chip per remaining shift (testID shift-0, shift-1) and a functional Pay ₹{amount} button. Checkout when CLOSED hides Pickup Slot, renders a red 'Restaurant is closed' banner with the open_status_text, and the Pay button is disabled (aria-disabled=true) with label 'Closed' — the closed-block therefore prevents any Razorpay call from the client. Ops VendorForm (desktop 1440x900, admin) Edit modal replaces the old Pickup Start/Pickup End fields with an 'Operating Hours' HoursEditor (Copy Monday + all 7 days visible). No deprecated Expo packages or React Native red screens observed on the tested screens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L2687 (ops_update_vendor) still writes pickup_start_time/pickup_end_time defaults ('18:00'/'21:00') whenever body omits them — this is dead legacy state now that hours drive open/closed. Consider dropping those defaults so partial PUTs don't overwrite a vendor's real pickup times, and eventually remove the columns entirely (still emitted in _vendor_public).

src/ops/forms.tsx L27 default state still includes pickup_start_time/pickup_end_time defaults sent on create — harmless since backend prefers hours, but the OpsVendorBody now accepts `hours`, so posting the legacy fields is redundant.

src/ops/forms.tsx L107 the Status Chips only offer ['active','inactive']. With the vendor compliance rework (Aug 2026) the real statuses are draft/pending_verification/active/rejected/suspended and only admin can set active. This is orthogonal to hours but the form still exposes 'inactive' which the backend doesn't recognise as a compliance state — flagging for the main agent, not a hours-feature bug.

server.py _open_status L761 uses `for offset in range(0,8)` and returns as soon as it finds any shift; because it iterates today first, the 'Opening again at HH:MM' text is correctly used for a later-today shift and 'Opens tomorrow at HH:MM' / 'Opens {Day} at HH:MM' for future days — verified in the closed test.

checkout.tsx correctly hides the Pickup Slot section when isClosed and forces the Pay button to `Closed` with disabled state; the visible `PICKUP SLOT` heading is uppercased via CSS (sectionTitle textTransform) so a text-based assertion on 'Pickup Slot' would miss — testIDs shift-0/shift-1 are the reliable selector.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows verified (vendor Hours editor + save, Ops VendorForm hours, home Open/Closed pill, restaurant detail chip+today hours, checkout Pickup Slot when open, checkout Closed banner + disabled Pay when closed)

seed_data_creation: Created ACTIVE vendor TEST UI Hours 1787308882 (vendor_f7332644f10b, login: TEST_uihours_1787308882@test.in / UiPass123!) with one menu item 'UI Test Croissant' (menu_7adbe91a9cbe) via /api/ops/vendors + /api/ops/vendors/{id}/menu; toggled its weekly hours via /api/vendor/hours to open-now and closed-now to exercise both UI paths. All these were DELETED via DELETE /api/ops/vendors/{vendor_id} (200 'Vendor deleted') at the end. Backend pytest fixtures created and self-cleaned an additional TEST_hours_* vendor per module. Two/three throwaway customer registrations (TEST_uicust*/TEST_cust_*@test.in) remain — no PII, no delete endpoint exposed. Draft vendor draftvendor@test.in was NOT touched. Razorpay was NOT called for real payment: the open-checkout test stops after POST /api/orders/create returns razorpay_order_id (pending_orders row), and the closed path returns 400 before Razorpay.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression: `export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://perfectly-good-build.preview.emergentagent.com && python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_operating_hours.py -v`. The module-scoped fixture creates and deletes its own ACTIVE vendor + menu item + one customer per run (open-now weekly schedule keyed off IST). If run near midnight IST or with `_weekly_open_now` producing s1_end within 5 min of s1_start the fixture falls back to a 30-min shift — still open-now. GET /api/restaurants/{id} returns {vendor:{...}, menu_items:[...], surplus_items:[...]} — the hours fields live under `vendor` (not top-level). Checkout URL carries the isOpen/openStatusText/todayShifts as query params so the /checkout screen doesn't refetch the vendor; if you flip vendor hours after landing on checkout the UI won't hot-update until re-navigated (this is expected).
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification pass, no bugs found.
